svg.title: Meteorite Classification Model
svg.desc: Two real competition test photos. After the ensemble blend, specimen 000120 moved from rank 87 to 84 and was submitted as a meteorite. Specimen 000070 moved from 86 to 88 and was submitted as a non-meteorite. The whole submission scored 0.86046 F1 on the Stage 2 private test set.

g.text: The ensemble labeled the top 86 of 194 test photos as meteorites.
